s: Sheyyakol lehatnot al hannetila, ubo b' seipim: notel adam yadayv shacharit umatneh alehem lekol hayyom kullo, apillu shello bishat haddechaq, ubilbad shello yassiach dato mishshemiratan minnegia bemaqom metunnap. Veim hinnichan bebatte yadayim — en leka shemira meulla mizzo. Umikkol maqom, im nizdammenu lo mayim mukanim lepanayv veen tzarik litroach acharehem — tob sheyyachazor veyittol, velo yebarek. Velo bintilat shacharit lebad moil tenay, ella kol hayyom, bekol zeman shennotel yadayv shello letzorek akilat pat, kegon ledabar shettibbulo bemashqeh, o sheyyotze mibbet hakkisse — matneh alehen laakilat pat sheyyokal achar kak, lepi shennetilat yadayim tzerika kavvana, kemo shennitbaer besiman qn"ch. Veap al pi shettabal bemashqeh veyotze mibbet hakkisse lo yebarek "al netilat yadayim", ubishat akila gam ken lo yebarek "al netilat yadayim" al zeh shennatal kebar — en bekak kelum, shehare patur hu min hannetila, kevan sheyyadayv shemurot. Abal im eno notel ella letzorek akilat pat sheyyokal achar kak — asur, ki taqqanat chakamim hi shettehe tekep lintilat yadayim seuda, mah sheen ken keshennotel shello letzorek akilat pat ella shemmatneh alehen sheyyukal leekol al yede zeh achar kak, eno mechuyyab kelal leekol akshav, veachar kak keshebba leekol — kebar hu patur min hannetila, velo chala alayv taqqanat hachakamim kelal, shello tiqqenu ella benotel laakila sheyyokal miyyad, vezeh lo natal laakila, ella ledabar acher. Veim natal yadayv laakila — moelet netila zo gam laakila acheret im shamar yadayv. Vaapillu tenay en tzarik, shehattenay eno ella mishshum kavvana, vezeh nitkavven (lintila baakila) [laakila bintila] zo. Veakshav nahagu shello lehatnot al hannetila, lepi sheyyesh omerim sheen tenay moil ella bishat haddechaq, lepi shechasheshu shemma yabou lehaakilo dabar haasur kesheyyiruhu okel belo netila, sheyyisberu shehu nokri. Umikkol maqom, im yosheb baagala im nokri veen mamtinim alayv — hare zeh sheat haddechaq:

Mi sheomed bisuda venizkar shennaga bemaqom metunnap — tzarik lachazor velittol yadayv, vibarek "al netilat yadayim". Veim naga beod happerusa bepiv — lo yibla ad sheyyittol yadayv. Velo meqom hattinnopet mammash, ella apillu shoq veyarek umeqomot hamkussim baadam, lepi sheyyesh bahem milmule zea. Veken im chikkek berosho, vekol kayyotze bazeh (abal im shipshep yadayv al rosho millemala, kegon lenaggebah, velo chikkek bah tok hassear berosho mammash — en lachosh). Veyesh omerim sheen lebarek "al netilat yadayim" beemtza hasseuda, ki lo tiqqenu ella bitchillatah, ella im ken hipsiq seudato vehalak lehaplig bedabar acher vehissiach dato mishshemirat yadayv, shetztzarik lachazor velittol ulebarek "al netilat yadayim", ki kisuda acheret hi hoil vehiplig benetayim, abal mishshum negia bimqom hattinnopet, vaapillu asa tzerakayv — en lebarek "al netilat yadayim". (Shekkol haoseh mitzva achat b' peamim — eno chozer umebarek, ella im ken hiplig benetayim, o shehissiach dato mimmenna vechazar venimlak, o shepposqa hammitzva meatzmah vechozer laasotah, kegon shennishmeta venopla tallito mealayv, kemo shennitbaer siman ch'. Abal zeh shehipsiq tohorat yadayim beyadayim al menat lachazor uletaharan, o shello middaat kelal, ubedato lo haya metammean ki im al daat lachazor uletaharan — en zeh chashub hepseq betohoratan lachazor ulebarek keshechozer umetaharan, kevan shello hissiach dato milletaharan, shehare apillu mi shemmesir tallito middato bistam — en tzarik lachazor ulebarek im nishar alayv tallit qatan, sheyyesh bazeh gilluy daat sheeno massiach dato mimmitzva zo, ap al pi sheen bedato kelum al tallit zo, veeno yodea im yachazor veyitattep bah, kemo shennitbaer sham, kol shekken zeh shehaddabar yadua shebbevadday yachazor lemitzvato letaher et yadayv, shehare hu meseb basseuda vedato leekol).
